summary.tldr: Amends the Income Tax Act to treat some tax avoidance transactions as misuse when the tax benefit is bigger than the transaction’s real financial benefit.
what_it_does: Adds a new rule under section 245 of the Income Tax Act for “economic substance”.

Deems an avoidance transaction to be a misuse of tax benefit rules if the tax benefit, directly or indirectly, is greater than the transaction’s actual or expected financial benefit, unless proven otherwise.
summary.background: The bill changes section 245 of the Income Tax Act, which deals with misuse of tax benefit provisions.
